concept: Standing by a principle even when it costs social standing
source_inspiration: original content, informed by Joan of Arc's principled-stand legacy — not sourced from any external text

exercise.scenario: Student faces a realistic scenario where holding a principled position risks real social cost among peers
exercise.branching_choice: Student decides how to navigate holding the position while managing the social fallout
exercise.practice: Socratic follow-up on what made this genuinely difficult, not just theoretically

assessment.success_marker: student names the specific social cost they weighed, not just an abstract commitment to 'doing the right thing'
